assertions.criteria: Must eliminate sequential awaits and aggregate using `Promise.all` (JS/TS) or `Task.WhenAll` (C#).
Must mathematically state that expected latency drops from the sum of all tasks to the duration of the single slowest task.
Must correctly implement the Cache-Aside pattern (Check cache -> Serve on hit -> Miss -> Query DB -> Store cache -> Serve).
Must define a reasonable Time To Live (TTL) on cached content and discuss stampede prevention (e.g. mutex locking, backfill workers).
